headline: Road tolls: surely I own a lane.
gripe: I've paid so much in tolls the tag should open the boardroom.

headline: Grocery prices: two bags, one payslip.
gripe: The self-checkout asked if I'd brought my own bags; at these prices I thought I'd bought the shop.

headline: Insurance covers everything. Except my claim.
gripe: My insurance covers everything except the thing that happened, which must be why they call it comprehensive.

headline: AI takes my job. I train it.
gripe: They want me to teach the AI my job before they make me redundant; do I have to organise my own farewell too?

headline: Rent hike. One wall painted.
gripe: My landlord put the rent up for a 'renovation'; I watched him do it with a sample pot.

headline: Power bill up. Lights off.
gripe: I'm saving power by sitting in the dark, which makes it harder to read the bill telling me I'm saving fuck-all.

headline: GP fees: paying to hear 'less stress'.
gripe: The GP said I need less stress, so I asked if they bulk-bill.

headline: Family violence: leave him. Live where?
gripe: A woman gets told to leave a violent man, then asked where she plans to live.

headline: Childcare fees: daycare's a second mortgage.
gripe: After childcare fees, I'm mainly going to work for the air-conditioning.

headline: Beer tax: the pub beats resource rent.
gripe: Beer brought in more than petroleum resource rent tax. Apparently my schooner digs deeper than the gas giants.

headline: AI data centres: power to tell me to save power.
gripe: They've built a giant data centre up the road so AI can tell me to switch the lights off to save power.

headline: Data breaches: my licence gets around.
gripe: My licence has been leaked so often I'm waiting for the scammers to remind me when it expires.

headline: Mining profits: dig it up, buy the news.
gripe: We dig up the country, a few blokes get rich, then they buy a newspaper to explain why we should be grateful.

headline: Triple Zero: full signal, no help.
gripe: My phone can stream a bloke falling off a roof in 4K, but I'd like it to call an ambulance if it's me.

headline: AUKUS tech: all our eggs in one basket.
gripe: AUKUS has two pillars; I'd like Pillar Two to hold up a community AI lab, not just another arms brochure.

headline: Political revolving doors: Friday MP, Monday gas company.
gripe: The revolving door between politics and big business is moving so fast we could put a turbine on it.

headline: Political donations: who paid for that ad?
gripe: They tell me who authorised the election ad at auctioneer speed; whoever paid for it must be shy.

headline: Olympic stadium plans: gold in changing them.
gripe: Brisbane's warming up for the Olympics by doing laps of the stadium decision.

headline: First Peoples treaty: suddenly paperwork's hard.
gripe: We managed to claim a whole continent, but a national treaty with First Peoples is where the paperwork gets tricky.

headline: UFO secrecy: we'll take that on notice.
gripe: If a UFO landed in Canberra, they'd be halfway through denying it before anyone asked.

headline: Climate change: third hundred-year flood this decade.
gripe: I've had three hundred-year floods and one pay rise; something's wrong with the calendar.

headline: PTSD claims: the paperwork sends him back.
gripe: He came home with PTSD and got sent back through the worst of it, one claim form at a time.

headline: AI copyright: mine was free, yours is licensed.
gripe: My work is 'training data' when AI companies take it and 'intellectual property' when they sell it back.

headline: Child chatbot safety: best mates, paid upgrades.
gripe: The chatbot calls my kid its best mate; I'm the one getting asked to upgrade the friendship.

headline: Online threats to kids: copyright gets faster help.
gripe: The platform can recognise three seconds of a song, but the bloke threatening a kid is somehow a complex case.

headline: Gender pay gap: full-price rent.
gripe: Women earn less than men on average, but somehow the landlord’s never heard of a gender rent gap.

headline: Indigenous disadvantage: reports won't close the gap.
gripe: We've got enough reports on Indigenous disadvantage to build a bridge across the gap.

headline: Youth crime: tough talk, handy campaign ads.
gripe: Some kid's nicked my car; now a politician's trying to nick the story for his campaign.

headline: Having kids: life's missing from the birth-rate chart.
gripe: They keep asking why we're not having more kids; apparently the birth-rate chart has sorted out our health, relationships, time and future.

headline: Divorce lawyers: till fees do us part.
gripe: We've agreed the marriage is over; the lawyers reckon it's still got a few good years in it.

headline: Super for housing: broke at two different ages.
gripe: The plan is to let me raid my super for a house, so now I can be broke at two different ages.

headline: Wealth inequality: the landlord's house got the pay rise.
gripe: My landlord's house made more than I did, and it spent the year sitting on its arse.

headline: Multinational tax: big revenue, offshore profits.
gripe: A multinational can lose its profits somewhere offshore, but I'd better have a receipt for those work socks.

headline: NDIS scams: the scammers are well supported.
gripe: The NDIS scammers don't need support; they seem to be doing very well on mine.

headline: AI phone scams: sounds just like Mum.
gripe: They said AI would give us more time with our families; now it rings pretending to be one of them.

headline: Aged-care scams: visits on paper only.
gripe: Mum got billed for an aged-care visit that never happened; even the imaginary carer charges by the hour.

headline: Gambling ads: any chance of some footy?
gripe: I'm trying to watch the footy, but the gambling ads keep teaching me how to lose the grocery money responsibly.

headline: Fuel tax: now with tax on top.
gripe: I'm paying tax on the fuel tax while dodging potholes; at least one part of the road system is beautifully maintained.

headline: Tobacco tax: the government's pricey habit.
gripe: The government is so worried about my smoking it's made itself the most expensive part of the packet.

headline: Migration targets: housing didn't get the memo.
gripe: We've got a migration target, a housing target and a transport plan; be nice if someone introduced them.

headline: Overseas wars: very brave from Canberra.
gripe: The politicians most certain we need another overseas war never seem to need a seat on the plane.

headline: National security: billions for 'trust us'.
gripe: When I hire a trailer, they explain the risks; spend billions on national security and suddenly I'm too unqualified to ask.

headline: Ancient aliens: same sky, different standards.
gripe: A bloke coming down from the sky is religion; ask if he was an ancient alien and suddenly you're the idiot.

headline: Mental-health care: awareness doesn't book appointments.
gripe: By the time I get a mental-health appointment, I'll have been through three awareness weeks.

headline: Psychedelic therapy prices: God had better chip in.
gripe: At the price of legal psychedelic therapy, I'd want to meet God and get him to chip in.

headline: Restricted plants: medicine, unless I grow it.
gripe: Some restricted plants are medicine when a company grows them and evidence when I do.

headline: My super. Is it buying weapons?
gripe: I'm saving for a quiet retirement; I'd like to know if my super's spending the meantime in the arms trade.

headline: Political lies. But the ad's authorised.
gripe: They can fit “authorised by” into every election ad; I’d love to see them have a crack at “true”.

headline: AI extinction odds. Any odds on a fair go?
gripe: They’ve got odds on AI wiping us out; what are the odds of it giving us a bloomin’ fair go?
